title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.09484v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training and evaluating interactive language agents typically requires rich user interactions, yet collecting human feedback is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulated users offer a scalable alternative, but they must both resemble real user behavior and provide useful learning experiences for agents. In contrast, most agent-training frameworks rely on off-the-shelf assistant LLMs, whose helpfulness can make them overly cooperative, explicit, and behaviorally homogeneous compared with real users. We introduce MIMESIS, a purpose-built user simulator trained on human conversations with explicit reasoning supervision and 13 realistic behavioral patterns derived from real user interactions. translated_title: MIMESIS：学习用户模拟器作为交互式智能体的训练环境
translated_abstract: 训练和评估交互式语言智能体通常需要丰富的用户交互，然而收集人类反馈成本高昂且难以规模化。模拟用户提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但它们既要贴近真实用户的行为，又要能为智能体提供有价值的学习体验。相比之下，大多数智能体训练框架依赖于现成的助手型大语言模型（LLM），其乐于助人的特性使它们与真实用户相比表现得过于配合、过于直白，且行为同质化。我们提出了 MIMESIS，一个专门构建的用户模拟器，它基于人类对话训练，采用显式推理监督，并从真实用户交互中提炼出 13 种现实的行为模式。实验表明，我们的 9B 模型达到了 65.7 的 SOUL-Index，超越了最强的前沿模型。与在 RealUserSim 和 SimulatorArena 上最强的基线 Claude-Opus-5 相比，MIMESIS 将行为保真度提升了 13.4 个百分点，并降低了……
tldr: 提出 MIMESIS——一种基于人类对话训练、具有显式推理监督和 13 种真实行为模式的专用用户模拟器，可作为交互式智能体的训练环境，其 9B 模型在 SOUL-Index 上超越最强前沿模型，并将行为保真度较最强基线提升 13.4 个百分点。
en_tdlr: MIMESIS is a purpose-built user simulator trained on human conversations with explicit reasoning supervision and 13 realistic behavioral patterns, serving as a training environment for interactive agents; its 9B model surpasses the strongest frontier model on SOUL-Index and improves behavioral fidelity by 13.4 points over the strongest baseline.
